mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_action_log (CO_ID, USER_ID, ACTION_SE_CD, MENU_NM, TARGET_ID, REQUEST_URI, CLIENT_IP_ADDR, ACTION_CN, REG_DT) VALUES (#{coId}, #{userId}, #{actionSeCd}, #{menuNm}, #{targetId}, #{requestUri}, #{clientIpAddr}, #{actionCn}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT E.CLAIM_SN claimSn, E.BIZ_ID bizId, E.EXPNS_SE_CD expnsSeCd, E.PMT_MTHD_CD pmtMthdCd, E.CARD_LAST4 cardLast4, DATE_FORMAT(E.USE_YMD, '%Y-%m-%d') useYmd, E.MERCHANT_NM merchantNm, E.EXPNS_NM expnsNm, E.CLAIM_AMT claimAmt, E.RMRK_CN rmrkCn FROM expense_claim E WHERE E.CO_ID = #{coId} AND E.CLAIM_SN = #{claimSn} LIMIT 1

SELECT W.WORK_ITEM_SN workItemSn, W.BIZ_ID bizId, W.PRIORITY_NO priorityNo, DATE_FORMAT(W.EXPT_END_YMD, '%Y-%m-%d') exptEndYmd, W.WORK_SE_CD workSeCd, W.WORK_CN workCn, COALESCE(P.PRGRS_STTS_CD, W.PRGRS_STTS_CD) prgrsSttsCd, COALESCE(P.PRGRS_RT, W.PRGRS_RT, 0) prgrsRt, COALESCE(P.ISSUE_CN, W.ISSUE_CN) issueCn, COALESCE(P.NEXT_PLAN_CN, W.NEXT_PLAN_CN) nextPlanCn FROM daily_work_item W LEFT JOIN daily_work_progress P ON P.WORK_ITEM_SN = W.WORK_ITEM_SN AND P.PRGRS_YMD = #{workYmd} AND P.USE_YN = 'Y' WHERE W.CO_ID = #{coId} AND W.USER_ID = #{userId} AND W.WORK_ITEM_SN = #{workItemSn} AND W.USE_YN = 'Y' LIMIT 1

SELECT M.MENU_SN menuSn, CONCAT(CASE WHEN P.MENU_NM IS NULL OR P.MENU_NM = '' THEN '' ELSE CONCAT(P.MENU_NM, ' > ') END, M.MENU_NM) menuLabel FROM menu_info M LEFT JOIN menu_info P ON P.MENU_SN = M.UP_MENU_SN WHERE M.MENU_USE_YN = 'Y' AND M.AUTHRT_CHK_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY M.WORKSPC_ID, IFNULL(P.MENU_SORT_SEQ, M.MENU_SORT_SEQ), M.MENU_SORT_SEQ, M.MENU_SN
